name: Order
description: Entity representing an order in the system with all associated details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Identifier of the user who placed the order

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: Date and time when the order was placed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the order in its lifecycle

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total monetary amount of the order

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Address where the order should be shipped

fields.name: billingAddress
fields.description: Address for billing purposes

fields.name: items
fields.description: List of items included in the order

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to the payment transaction for this order

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes or special instructions for the order

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of the order based on all items

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the order and recalculates the total amount

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the order by its ID and recalculates the total amount

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the order

name: OrderItem
description: Entity representing an item within an order, including quantity and pricing

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order item

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the parent order

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Reference to the product being ordered

fields.name: productName
fields.description: Name of the product at the time of order (for historical reference)

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units ordered

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Price per unit at the time of order

fields.name: totalPrice
fields.description: Total price for this item (quantity * unitPrice)

fields.name: discountAmount
fields.description: Amount of discount applied to this item

methods.name: calculateTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the total price for this item based on quantity and unit price, applying any discounts

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity and recalculates the total price

methods.name: applyDiscount
methods.description: Applies a percentage discount to this item and recalculates the total price

name: Cart
description: Entity representing a user's shopping cart with items before conversion to an order

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the cart

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Identifier of the user who owns the cart

fields.name: createdDate
fields.description: Date and time when the cart was created

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Date and time when the cart was last modified

fields.name: items
fields.description: Items currently in the shopping cart

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total monetary amount of all items in the cart

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart or increments quantity if it already exists

methods.name: updateItemQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an item in the cart

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of all items in the cart

methods.name: convertToOrder
methods.description: Converts the cart to an order entity

name: CartItem
description: Entity representing an item in the shopping cart before conversion to an order item

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the cart item

fields.name: cartId
fields.description: Reference to the parent cart

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Reference to the product in the cart

fields.name: productName
fields.description: Name of the product (cached for display purposes)

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units in the cart

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Current price per unit

fields.name: totalPrice
fields.description: Total price for this item (quantity * unitPrice)

fields.name: dateAdded
fields.description: Date and time when the item was added to the cart

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity and recalculates the total price

methods.name: calculateTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the total price for this item based on quantity and unit price

methods.name: convertToOrderItem
methods.description: Converts the cart item to an order item

name: OrderStatus
description: Enumeration of possible order statuses in the order lifecycle

fields.name: CREATED
fields.description: Order has been created but not processed yet

fields.name: PAYMENT_PENDING
fields.description: Order is waiting for payment confirmation

fields.name: PAYMENT_CONFIRMED
fields.description: Payment has been confirmed for the order

fields.name: PROCESSING
fields.description: Order is being processed (items gathered, packaged, etc.)

fields.name: SHIPPED
fields.description: Order has been shipped to the delivery address

fields.name: DELIVERED
fields.description: Order has been successfully delivered to the customer

fields.name: CANCELED
fields.description: Order has been canceled

fields.name: REFUNDED
fields.description: Order has been refunded

methods.name: isTerminalState
methods.description: Returns true if this status represents an end state in the order lifecycle

methods.name: canTransitionTo
methods.description: Checks if a transition from the current status to the next status is valid

name: OrderRepository
description: Interface for data access operations on orders

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an order by its unique identifier

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds all orders for a specific user

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Finds all orders with a specific status

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an order in the database

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an order by its ID

methods.name: findOrdersCreatedBetween
methods.description: Finds orders created within a specified date range

name: CartRepository
description: Interface for data access operations on shopping carts

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a shopping cart by its unique identifier

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds the active shopping cart for a specific user

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a shopping cart in the database

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its ID

methods.name: findAbandonedCarts
methods.description: Finds carts that have not been updated since the specified date
